`final class ShadowShader`<br/>
**Extends:** [`ShaderProgram`](/reference/shaders/shaderprogram/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.shader.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ShadowShader.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/shader/impl/ShadowShader.java)

The shader of soft shadows, which draws the blurred silhouette of a rounded box.

## Description

[`DrawShape.drawShadow`](/reference/drawing/drawshape/#DrawShape-method-drawShadow) uses it.

- [Shaders](/use/learn/going-further/shaders/)

## Method details

<a id="ShadowShader-method-use"></a>

### use

`void use(float radius, float blur, float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, Runnable runnable)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Runs `runnable` with the shader bound on the box `x1`, `y1`, `x2`, `y2`, its corner `radius` and its `blur`, then restores the previous shader.
Draw a quad that covers the box plus 1.5 times the blur on each side.

<a id="ShadowShader-method-bind"></a>

### bind

`void bind(float radius, float blur, float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2)` 

Binds the shader on the box, with every corner rounded.

<a id="ShadowShader-method-sides"></a>

### sides

`void sides(boolean left, boolean top, boolean right, boolean bottom)` 

Rounds only the corners of the chosen sides, as [`DrawShape.drawRoundedRect`](/reference/drawing/drawshape/#DrawShape-method-drawRoundedRect) does; call it after `bind`.
